Written by

Feature screenplay · First draft

01 EXT. ANCIENT CITY - NIGHT

FADE IN:

A city older than its ruins will ever suggest.

Towers climb through luminous haze. Ships move between them without wings. Channels of blue light pass beneath transparent streets.

At the city's edge stands a PYRAMID. Light descends through its center into the earth.

One airborne ship shudders. Its running lights stretch into seven separate images.

On a terrace, NOAH, weathered and alert, holds a wooden cup. The water inside climbs one wall of the cup.

His youngest son, JAPHETH, watches a ship correct its course.

JAPHETH

They said it was contained.

A metal fastening tears out of the terrace railing. Noah catches Japheth before he can reach for it.

The fastening shoots upward. Others follow, striking the underside of a passing ship like gunfire.

NOAH

Get your mother.

JAPHETH

The engineers--

NOAH

Now.

Japheth runs. Noah looks at the wooden cup. The water falls back into place.

Behind him, someone inside a dark building calls his name.
